title: 第15章 魔道法门丹道真解第16章 众所周知哪吒的爹其实是玲珑塔
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 剑光细微，并不璀璨夺目，也无冲天锋芒。
但却让豹王感受到了死亡危机。
生死之间，他几乎是本能般的爆发了全部力量。
混杂着血红色的法力倾巢而出，好似滔滔血海，席卷开来！
一瞬间，这片虚空都被弥漫，欲要碾压一切。
苍狼精和白花蛇精此时躲在叶云背后，虽然没有被波及。
但那法力浩荡之中散发出的力量，也让他们颤栗不已，抱在了一团。
就在这时，剑光已至，一缕寒气释放。
豹王那咆哮浩瀚的法力，直接被冻结在那里，形成了冰雕奇景。
见此，豹王神色惊恐的欲要逃离。
但还没等他挪动脚步，寒气已然蔓延了过来。
下一瞬，豹王就被寒气包裹，成为了寒冰的一部分。
一切发生在眨眼之间。
等苍狼精和白花蛇精反应过来后，就看到一度让他们绝望的豹王。
就这么被这位黄风大王给收拾了，不费吹灰之力！
这黄风大王之强，超乎他们的想象！
叶云如同做了一件微不足道的小事，望向两妖道：
“考虑的如何了？是否拜入我麾下。”
两妖相视一眼，然后齐齐朝着叶云行礼：“我等愿意，拜见大王！”
他俩也不是傻子，从叶云的行事风格就能看出来，这位黄风大王跟豹王那种以力压人，残忍暴戾的姿态完全不一样。
而且实力这么强，还愿意询问他们。
换成其他妖怪，怕是二话不说就直接动手了。
最重要的是，救下了他俩的命。
不过，其实即便没有叶云出手，他俩也不会死。
那豹王也就是吓唬吓唬这两妖，需要为他炼丹罢了。
当然，豹王想杀叶云的心是有的。
此时，叶云听到两妖的回答，点了点头，“好，既入我麾下，那我给你们两个选择。”
“一是选择跟我离去，回到黄风岭；二是选择继续留在黑风山。”
两妖闻言想了想，齐齐答道：“大王，我们兄弟想要留在黑风山。”
毕竟这里是生他们养他们之地，如果有选择，也不想背井离乡。
“既如此，那你们就留在这里，替我管理黑风山，定期采摘天材地宝。”
content_en:
The sword light was subtle, not dazzling, nor did it have a sky-high edge.
But it made the Leopard King feel the crisis of death.
Between life and death, he exploded with all his strength almost instinctively.
The mana mixed with blood red poured out, like a torrential sea of ​​blood, sweeping away!
In an instant, the void was filled, trying to crush everything.
The Blue Wolf Spirit and the White Flower Snake Spirit were hiding behind Ye Yun, although they were not affected.
But the power emanating from the mighty mana also made them tremble and hug each other.
At this moment, the sword light arrived and a wisp of cold air was released.
The roaring and vast mana of the Leopard King was directly frozen there, forming an ice sculpture wonder.
Seeing this, the Leopard King looked horrified and wanted to escape.
But before he could move, the cold air had already spread over him.
The next moment, the Leopard King was wrapped in the cold air and became part of the ice.
Everything happens in the blink of an eye.
When the Blue Wolf Spirit and White Flower Snake Spirit reacted, they saw the Leopard King who had once made them despair.
He was taken care of by the Yellow Wind King without any effort!
The power of King Huangfeng was beyond their imagination!
Ye Yun looked at the two demons as if he had done something trivial and said:
"How are you thinking? Do you want to join me?"
The two demons looked at each other, and then saluted Ye Yun together: "We are willing to pay homage to the king!"
They are not fools. It can be seen from Ye Yun's behavior that King Huangfeng is completely different from the Leopard King who uses force to suppress others and is cruel and violent.
And he is so strong that he is willing to ask them.
If it had been any other monster, he would have taken action without saying a word.
The most important thing is to save their lives.
However, in fact, even if Ye Yun had not taken action, they would not have died.
The Leopard King was just trying to scare these two demons and needed to make elixirs for him.
Of course, the Leopard King wanted to kill Ye Yun.
At this time, Ye Yun heard the answers from the two demons and nodded, "Okay, now that you are under my command, I will give you two choices."
"The first is to choose to leave with me and return to Huangfengling; the second is to choose to stay in Heifeng Mountain."
After hearing this, the two demons thought for a while and replied together: "Your Majesty, our brothers want to stay in Black Wind Mountain."
After all, this is the place where they were born and raised. If I had the choice, I wouldn't want to leave my hometown.
"In that case, then you will stay here, manage Black Wind Mountain for me, and regularly pick treasures from heaven and earth."
